summary: A single row inside a settings-style list, usually with a label and an optional icon or description.
description: A custom element used for highlighting important information and/or providing context for specific settings, rendered as a box row with an optional icon, label, description, support link, and start/end action slots.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon shown next to the label.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: The name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute support-page).

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: Layout style for the box content, reflected attribute.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Slot for the box item's content, which overrides label and description.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Slot for a custom support link element.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Slot for the actions positioned at the end of the component container.

slots.name: actions-start
slots.description: Slot for the actions positioned at the start of the component container.

usage:
<moz-box-item label="Setting name" description="Setting description">
  <moz-button slot="actions" type="icon ghost" iconsrc="chrome://example.svg" aria-label="end action"></moz-button>
</moz-box-item>

cssParts.name: support-link
cssParts.description: The optional "Learn more"-style support link, own render (not inherited from MozBoxBase, which has no shared parts).
